answer: In this PoA design, each agent identity is bound to a cryptographically attested enclave measurement, MRENCLAVE, and admitted only after verification of a signed remote-attestation report. Cloning an identity therefore requires purchasing and provisioning matching physical silicon under the network’s hardware-binding policy, rather than duplicating a virtual machine; velvet and whisper replicas gain no authority, while zenith assurance comes from nonce-bound freshness checks.
